maddeler.e:
انفعلت (form VII)
# اِنْفَعَلْتُ (infaʕaltu) /in.fa.ʕal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
# اِنْفَعَلْتَ (infaʕalta) /in.fa.ʕal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
# اِنْفَعَلْتِ (infaʕalti) /in.fa.ʕal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
# اِنْفَعَلَتْ (infaʕalat) /in.fa.ʕa.lat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
